subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets security-audit check mode ignore info-level findings?
rationale: The implementation is clean and default-compatible, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be ignored by operator gates is a security/product policy choice for the secrets audit surface.

options.title: Require secops sponsorship
options.body: Merge only after a maintainer/secops owner explicitly accepts the public threshold and confirms the current docs, tests, and terminal proof are enough.

options.title: Sponsor current flag
options.body: Accept the opt-in threshold as-is because plain `--check` still fails on all findings and the PR includes proof and docs.

options.title: Pause or close for now
options.body: Close or pause this contributor PR until audit policy is confirmed, then invite a sponsored replacement if the threshold is wanted.

recommendation.title: Require secops sponsorship
recommendation.body: Merge only after a maintainer/secops owner explicitly accepts the public threshold and confirms the current docs, tests, and terminal proof are enough.
